payload.body: Audit-scope implementation decision: Kanban completion will include the complete server-derived history for the bound CARD across all its grants and attempts through submission, ordered by immutable audit ID and explicitly labeled. This matches the existing full affected-RUN history in sprint retros and the card body asking equivalent complete evidence. A per-attempt timestamp exclusion was an unnecessary coordinating-session constraint, not a user requirement; removing it prevents same-millisecond/clock-rollback omissions without extra watermark schema. Earlier usage of the same card still requires per-capability suggestions; unrelated cards remain excluded. Distinct workflow target IDs and trusted boundCardId remain separate. No criterion or privacy requirement is waived. The remaining PID-reuse liveness gap is still a required correction before final gates.
